description: This file is a test script written in Shell that verifies the behavior of a 'noop' fetch negotiator in a Git-like environment. It sets up repositories, configures a 'noop' fetch negotiation algorithm, and checks that no 'have' messages are emitted during fetch, only confirming the proper operation of the 'noop' negotiator.
